items.title: Report the Adair County local hotel/motel tax
items.description: The Iowa Department of Revenue's current jurisdictions-and-rates workbook lists a 5% local hotel/motel tax for the Adair County jurisdiction. Report and remit the local tax with the monthly Iowa sales and use tax return; no separate permit beyond an Iowa sales and use tax permit is required.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: The Iowa Department of Revenue's workbook effective July 1, 2026 confirms a 5% local hotel/motel tax for the Adair County jurisdiction; other county-level obligations were not checked.
